scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @apunta/server" "npm run dev --workspace @apunta/web"
scripts.tauri:dev: node --input-type=module -e 'import { platformDataDir } from "./shared/src/platform-paths.ts"; import { homedir } from "node:os"; const norm = (v) => v.replaceAll("\\", "/").replace(/\/+$/, ""); const port = process.env.APUNTA_PORT; const data = process.env.APUNTA_DATA_DIR; const def = platformDataDir(process.platform, { ...process.env, APUNTA_DATA_DIR: undefined }, homedir()); const how = "node scripts/v2/sandbox.mjs run --port 78xx -- npm run tauri:dev"; if (port === "7717") { console.error("tauri:dev refuses APUNTA_PORT=7717: that is the live instance. Run it as: " + how); process.exit(1); } if (data !== undefined && data !== "" && (norm(data) === norm(def) || norm(data).startsWith(norm(def) + "/"))) { console.error("tauri:dev refuses APUNTA_DATA_DIR=" + data + ": that is the platform default (" + def + "). Run it as: " + how); process.exit(1); } console.log("tauri:dev guard: port " + (port || "(unset)") + ", data " + (data || "(unset)") + ". Run it as: " + how);' && tauri dev --features test-identity --config src-tauri/tauri.test.conf.json
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && node scripts/check-no-external-urls.mjs && node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs --check && node scripts/check-ui-strings.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @apunta/server && npm run build --workspace @apunta/installer && npm run build --workspace @apunta/web
scripts.eval: npm run build:shared && npm run eval --workspace @apunta/server --
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed --workspace @apunta/server --
